mission.goal: Create a provider-neutral autonomic capability fabric production foundation for CFBE.
mission.workflow: ingest estate snapshot, compile intent, resolve route, reconcile desired state, verify proof, publish through governed review
mission.data: public-safe typed JSON, SQLite state, hashes, receipts and blockers
mission.environment: local deterministic runtime first; provider adapters separately gated
mission.governance: Formation single-use permits, one effectful path, proof-before-promotion
mission.failure: fail closed with typed exceptions, atomic rollback, blockers and truthful state
mission.testing: unit, integration, failure-first, idempotency, backup and restore
mission.deployment: reversible GitHub branch and pull request; no production deployment in local build
mission.continuity: SQLite checkpoints, backup/restore, project memory and AI handoff

assumptions.storage: Local SQLite for Genesis; provider persistence separately gated
assumptions.authentication: Supplied only by separately authorized adapters and never stored here
assumptions.deployment: Reversible review branch before any provider deployment

components.frontend: NOT_APPLICABLE: CLI and library are the requested Genesis interfaces
components.backend: cfbe_acf compiler, resolver, trusted permit authority, proof kernel, reconciler and runtime
components.database: SQLite with foreign keys, WAL, mission registry, atomic authority/reservation transaction, global effect lease, fenced execution journal, signed state checkpoints, pinned store identity, rollback-resistant external HTTPS CAS anchor and signed provenance backup
components.queue: Fenced PENDING/COMMITTED/UNKNOWN execution journal and global cross-contract effect lease; external durable broker remains a provider gate
components.worker: On-demand governed runtime; durable worker identity remains unproven
components.scheduler: NOT_APPLICABLE: no scheduler is promoted in Genesis local source
components.cache: NOT_APPLICABLE: deterministic SQLite readback is sufficient for Genesis
components.authentication: No provider credentials stored; local HMAC reference authorities prove behavior while production identities remain external

observability.health_checks: runtime health, active blocker state, SQLite integrity, application row/chain verification, independently keyed checkpoint validation, pinned store identity and external CAS-anchor equality
observability.structured_logs: canonical JSON CloudEvents with W3C trace context
observability.audit_logs: hash-chained events, immutable attested receipts and runtime-keyed event/state checkpoints
observability.metrics_alerts: blocker counts and heartbeat freshness; external alert transport not yet deployed

testing.unit: compiler, resolver, proof and validation tests
testing.integration: Estate Twin plus SQLite plus runtime observation
testing.e2e_or_smoke: CLI init, ingest, plan, reconcile and health
testing.fixtures_mocks: public-safe 13-node snapshot and deterministic observation adapter
testing.failure_first: fake and replayed permits, mission supersession and stop/reservation races, same- and cross-contract concurrent effects, ambiguous persistence, injected/forged proof, provider tokens, self-consistent tampering, event and checkpoint truncation, checkpoint auto-reseal, cross-store identity substitution, anchor redirect, chronology, blocker lifecycle and signed restore provenance
commands: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=. python -m unittest discover -s tests -v

results.scope: local candidate after two independent adversarial reviews
results.command: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=. python -m unittest discover -s tests -v

delivery.file_tree: cfbe_autonomic_fabric package, examples, tests and governance documents
test_commands: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=. python -m unittest discover -s tests -v
deploy_commands: NOT_IN_PACKAGE: use an authorized GitHub connector to create a reversible review branch and draft pull request
rollback_commands: Close the unmerged pull request and delete only the bounded branch if rollback is authorized
delivery.debugging: Run health, SQLite integrity_check, tests and inspect blockers before retry

unavailable_capabilities: production Formation, JARVIS and Sentinel identities
watchman.preserved_core: deterministic local Estate Twin, compiler, resolver, proof and reconciliation

continuity.idempotency: full-contract SHA-256 keys, provider idempotency propagation, atomic per-contract fences, one global effect lease and UNKNOWN ambiguity holds
continuity.checkpoints: Explicit one-time empty-state Genesis provisioning, pre-write integrity verification inside write locks, SQLite transactions, application hashes, store/checkpoint-bound HMAC event/state roots, independently pinned store identity, redirect-disabled external HTTPS CAS trusted anchor and signed provenance-bound backup
continuity.resume_conditions: current mission, current source fingerprint and successful integrity readback
continuity.stop_switch: Formation stop or mission supersession prevents further effectful execution

semantic_verification.fruit: 13 stale node heartbeats plus one unverified provider generated 14 durable blockers and no completion claim; repaired heartbeat blockers are explicitly superseded
